title: Make a strong convention for render and _render in connectors

comments.body: What's your suggestion for the convention @bobylito ?

It's not clear in mind, which one of the `_refine` and `render` should be which implementation. And I don't think we're completly consistent accross the actual implementation.

Given that `_` denotes private elements, and that we one of the values is directly usable (because it is bound to the helper) and it will be passed to the render function, it should be this one that is without underscore. The raw one (that requires the helper) should be the "private" one.

But beyond my arguments about which should be what, we should have consistency of implementation.
This may not be that important.
